descriptions.zh: 我们必须调校视界刺针跃迁引擎，计算精确的坐标，让我们可以潜入河心超大质量黑洞。
descriptions.en: We need to calibrate the jump drive of the Horizon Needle and calculate the exact coordinates that will allow us to dive into the supermassive black hole at the galactic core.

descriptions.zh: 派出一支队伍去修正[root.location.getName]的重力变化，恢复其大气层。
descriptions.en: Send a team to rectify the gravitational changes on [root.location.getName] and restore its atmosphere.

descriptions.zh: 在寒冷环境居住的人口汇报了各种与义体植入体有关的疼痛症状。通过临床实验可以让我们获得更多数据。
descriptions.en: Populations living in freezing climates report cases of severe pains related to cybernetic implants. A clinical trial will allow us to gather more data.

descriptions.zh:
一场无法解释的宇宙风暴凭空出现，阻挡了通行。

为了继续前进，我们必须穿透它神秘的帷幕。
descriptions.en:
An unexplained cosmic tempest has materialized, blocking all travel.

To proceed, we must pierce its mysterious veil.

descriptions.zh:
塞塔娜的风暴既是一项技术奇迹，也是一件可怕的武器。

如果我们要在对抗她的斗争中有什么胜算，我们一定要学习更多，特别是因为她的图谋和她的宣称相去甚远。
descriptions.en:
Cetana's tempest is both a technological marvel and a formidable weapon.

We must learn more if we are to stand any chance against her, especially if her intentions deviate from what she has implied.

descriptions.zh:
塞塔娜委任我们从[Root.GetName]取回一个数据库，并警告我们不要尝试破译其中的内容。

这些数据的价值不言而喻，我们能冒着惹她不高兴的危险进行解密吗？
descriptions.en:
Cetana has tasked us with retrieving a databank from [Root.GetName], warning us to make no attempt to decipher its contents.

The significance of this data is veiled, but can we risk arousing her displeasure by uncovering it?

descriptions.zh: 随着塞塔娜的风暴径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]，在它到达之前我们几乎已经没有多少时间了。
descriptions.en: With Cetana's tempest speeding towards [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName], we will have little time to grab the databank before it arrives.

descriptions.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
descriptions.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

descriptions.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
descriptions.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

descriptions.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
descriptions.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

descriptions.zh:
即便壁垒层层，但§H[solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系的前哨还是不如塞塔娜的核心领地戒备森严。我们可以用一支足够强大的舰队摧垮它的防御。对残骸场进行全面的检测有可能挖掘出关于塞塔娜计划的重要洞见。关键的挑战在于穿越风暴到达前哨。

§R这将引发一场战斗！§!

§G成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。§!
descriptions.en:
While heavily fortified, the outpost in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system is less guarded than Cetana's core territory. With a sufficiently powerful fleet, we can overwhelm its defenses. A thorough examination of the debris field could yield important insights into Cetana's plans. The key challenge lies in navigating through the tempest to reach the outpost.

§RThis will start a battle!§!

§GSuccessful raids will hamper Cetana's plans.§!

descriptions.zh:
塞塔娜的运输舰队确保将关键资源运送到她的前哨。如果我们的舰队能抓到一艘，我们就能登船检查货物。

§R这将引发一场战斗！§!

§G成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。§!
descriptions.en:
Cetana's Convoys ensure the delivery of crucial resources to her outposts. If we can catch one with our fleets, we can board the ships and inspect their cargo.

§RThis will start a battle!§!

§G Successful raids will impede Cetana's plans.§!

descriptions.zh: 抟土之塑师不知用什么方法瘫痪了塞塔娜的泰坦。现在机会来了：如果我们想重塑塞塔娜，就必须做好[GetRitualGoalLoc]的准备工作。
descriptions.en: Somehow the Animator of Clay disabled Cetana's Titan. The chance is now: if we hope to reshape Cetana, we must prepare for the [GetRitualGoalLoc].
